answer_2.quote: All agents are evaluated with the success rate (Succ.) at the end of the training, average turn (Turn), average reward (Reward).

answer_4.quote: we deploy the agents ... to interact with human users ... users are required to give explicit feedback on whether the dialog succeeded ... evaluators rate the dialog session on a scale from 1 to 5 about the quality
answer_4.guideline: Users can end the session at any time if the agent Keeps repeating or they believe the dialog is going to be a failure. At the end of each session, users are required to give explicit feedback on whether the dialog succeeded with all the user constraints satisfied. Moreover, evaluators rate the dialog session on a scale from 1 to 5 about the quality
